founder_message.from: David Saddy Malingu, Founder and CEO
founder_message.message: 24 months ago, I collected this Afrika-shaped piece of rock, and promised to make it the most valuable rock in the world – increasing its value from zero to millions if not billions. How was I to achieve this miracle? By turning it into a digital asset that helps Afrikan brands and professionals to build their dreams, realize their visions, missions, goals, and ambitions. That's how Alphadome was born. 24 months down the line, we now have a fully fledged system that leverages automations and intelligent algorithms to research market opportunities, generate relevant branding content, utilize multiple communication channels to match brands with identified opportunities, convert leads to sales, and build information systems that set businesses in a path of scalable growth. Think of Alphadome as a network of dedicated digital employees handling your performance needs proactively, innovatively, and profitably. Now, the value of our Afrika rock grows with every brand we onboard, and every solution we deliver to these brands.

alphadome.core_purpose: Alphadome is a modular, AI- and blockchain-powered ecosystem designed to facilitate success in the digital age through systems that automate, optimize, and secure business, creative, industrial, and research operations. It serves brands, professionals, and organizations through agentic automation, digital asset creation and management (NFTs), and intelligent orchestration. The system is designed to understand users and develop systems and assets that enhance their capacity to leverage top-notch tech and thrive.
alphadome.mission: To empower Afrikan brands, professionals, and organizations with intelligent, modular systems that automate growth, optimize operations, and unlock digital-era value through AI agents, blockchain tokenization, and scalable information systems.

alpha_1_squad.overview: Alphadome's Alpha 1 squad is the core cohort of the first 1000 clients onboarded over the next 24 months, receiving priority focus, resources, and strategic support.
priority_benefits: Priority access to new 3.0 systems, agents, and NFTs
Custom system design and AI agent development (Building Plans 3.0, Intra Africa Journal Hub, KEMSA 3.0, etc.)
Physical robot/digital kiosk design and deployment (Alpha Bot Avatar designs)
Blockchain crowdfunding support for brand-specific 3.0 assets
Dedicated support team and revenue optimization services
Early access to tokenization and equity ownership models
alpha_1_squad.outcome: Each Alpha 1 client will have a custom digital ecosystem with AI agents, 3.0 information systems, branded NFTs, and physical embodiments (robots/digital kiosks) to drive their digital growth journey.

blockchain_crowdfunding_model.overview: Alphadome uses a blockchain-based crowdfunding model to fund the development and deployment of 3.0 Systems, AI Agents, NFTs, and physical robots for client brands.
blockchain_crowdfunding_model.mechanism: Users can purchase equity shares of specific 3.0 assets, granting them proportional ownership and revenue participation rights.
blockchain_crowdfunding_model.example_funding_flow: Users who purchase shares of Intra Africa Journal Hub 3.0 fund the creation of the publishing system, AI publishing agent, and branded NFTs. In return, share holders own proportional equity in the system and receive corresponding revenue from its operations.
blockchain_crowdfunding_model.revenue_sharing: Revenue generated by 3.0 assets (subscription fees, transaction commissions, API usage, NFT sales) is distributed to shareholders based on their ownership percentage.
benefits: Democratic value creation: Users participate in building systems they believe in
Decentralized funding: 3.0 development is funded by community investment, not debt or dilutive equity
Aligned incentives: Shareholders and Alphadome are aligned to maximize system value and adoption
Transparency: Blockchain ensures transparent tracking of ownership, revenue, and payouts
Scalability: Successful 3.0 systems attract investment and resources for rapid scaling
blockchain_crowdfunding_model.implementation: Blockchain smart contracts manage share issuance, ownership tracking, revenue collection, and automated payouts. Alphadome facilitates the crowdfunding campaigns and manages system governance.

client_portfolio.overview: Alphadome has built custom 3.0 systems and AI agents for diverse client brands across sectors including retail, fashion, pharmaceuticals, events, technology, hospitality, education, and professional services.
client_portfolio.portfolio_structure: Each Alphadome client receives a dedicated digital asset folder with the following structure: 3.0 Ecosystems (information systems and automation workflows), AI Agents (brand-specific AI assistants and automation), NFTs (tokenized brand assets for sales and marketing), and Collectibles (branded digital items for community engagement).

client_portfolio.revenue_model: Alphadome charges subscription fees for 3.0 systems, transaction commissions on sales, and licensing fees for AI agents. Clients benefit from automated growth, reduced operational costs, and diversified revenue through NFT sales.

phase_1_discovery.title: Discovery & Qualification
steps: Prospect completes Alphadome inquiry form or WhatsApp conversation
Alphadome team qualifies fit for Alpha 1 squad or standard client program
Initial consultation to understand brand, goals, and operational challenges
Define 3.0 system scope and potential AI agent applications
phase_1_discovery.outcome: Signed onboarding agreement and project charter

phase_2_system_design.title: System Design & Customization
steps: Alphadome team designs custom 3.0 system architecture for the brand
Identify primary and secondary information systems needed (e.g., CRM, inventory, catalog)
Design AI agent personalities and roles aligned with brand identity
Plan avatar/physical robot design (if applicable for Alpha 1 clients)
Define blockchain crowdfunding campaign for system and NFT monetization
phase_2_system_design.outcome: Detailed system design document and implementation roadmap

phase_3_implementation.title: Implementation & Deployment
steps: Build core 3.0 information system (database, dashboards, workflows)
Develop and train brand-specific AI agents
Integrate with client's existing systems (CRM, inventory, payment gateways)
Set up WhatsApp Business integration for customer engagement
Configure analytics and performance tracking
Deploy in staging environment for testing and refinement
phase_3_implementation.outcome: Fully functional 3.0 system in staging, ready for UAT

phase_4_avatar_design.title: Avatar Design & Prototyping (Alpha 1 clients)
steps: Collaborate with client on Avatar Universe design (using Alphadome's AI design tools)
Create multiple avatar design options reflecting brand personality
Client selects preferred avatar(s) and customizations
Prototype and validate avatar behavior/personality with LLM fine-tuning
Plan manufacturing and deployment timeline for physical robots/digital kiosks
phase_4_avatar_design.outcome: Approved Avatar design(s) and manufacturing plan

phase_5_crowdfunding.title: Blockchain Crowdfunding Campaign
steps: Prepare crowdfunding campaign details (system value, revenue projections, equity structure)
Create NFT designs representing shares and brand collectibles
Launch blockchain crowdfunding campaign to Alphadome community
Manage crowdfunding operations, share issuance, and investor communication
Allocate raised capital to system development and deployment
phase_5_crowdfunding.outcome: Fully funded 3.0 system with community ownership and aligned incentives

phase_6_launch.title: Production Launch & Support
steps: Deploy 3.0 system to production environment
Activate WhatsApp automation and customer engagement workflows
Launch avatar/robot deployment (if applicable)
Conduct staff training and onboarding
Establish performance baselines and KPI tracking
Activate dedicated support team for client success
phase_6_launch.outcome: Live 3.0 system generating revenue and customer engagement

phase_7_growth.title: Growth & Optimization
steps: Monitor system performance and analytics
Optimize AI agent behavior based on real-world interactions
Scale system to additional product lines or market segments
Add new AI agents and automation workflows
Expand physical avatar/robot deployment
Implement customer feedback and continuous improvements
phase_7_growth.outcome: Scalable, revenue-generating digital ecosystem for the brand

system_architecture.data_flow: API gateway routes requests to module microservices, which interact with PostgreSQL/Redis/Supabase for data, LLMs for AI, and blockchain for asset/token operations. Webhooks and external APIs are integrated for real-time events.
system_architecture.security_model: RBAC, JWT/OAuth2, encryption at rest and in transit, Row-Level Security (RLS), audit logs, per-tenant isolation.

deployment_ops.upgrade_strategy: Non-breaking SQL migrations, versioned deployments, rollback via backup scripts.

tenant_model.isolation: Each tenant has unique WhatsApp ID, access token, templates, and training data. DB schema enforces per-tenant isolation (see DB_ALIGNMENT_REPORT.md).
tenant_model.onboarding_flow: 1. Add tenant to DB (phone, token, config). 2. Upload templates and training data. 3. Assign admin dashboard access. 4. Verify via WhatsApp Cloud API.
tenant_model.customization: Per-tenant templates, features, analytics, and escalation policies.
security_checklist: Set up encryption for sensitive fields

context_awareness.propagation: Context is propagated via middleware, session state, and per-tenant DB records. Each bot request is enriched with tenant, user, and conversation context.
context_awareness.knowledge_base_usage: Knowledge base powers RAG, onboarding, FAQ, fallback, and admin queries. Context is retrieved per-tenant for accurate, secure automation.
context_awareness.example: When a user sends a message, the bot loads tenant config, templates, and relevant knowledge base entries to generate a context-aware response.

current_limitations: Some advanced features (e.g., process management in AlphaChip-OS, full tokenization in Ganji) are in progress.
Manual onboarding for new tenants (automation planned).

glossary.tenant: A client/business with isolated config, templates, and data.
glossary.fallback: Automated continuity mechanism for failed workflows.

security_compliance.encryption: All sensitive fields encrypted at rest and in transit.
security_compliance.rls: Row-Level Security policies enforced for all tenant data.
security_compliance.audit: Comprehensive audit logs for all admin and sensitive actions.
security_compliance.token_management: Access tokens are rotated and monitored for expiry.

example_use_cases.title: Tenant Onboarding
steps: Admin adds new tenant via dashboard or migration script.
Uploads templates and training data.
Assigns WhatsApp credentials and verifies integration.
Tenant receives unique dashboard access and can manage catalog.

example_use_cases.title: Campaign Launch
steps: Tenant configures campaign in dashboard.
Uploads product catalog and selects target audience.
Bot triggers WhatsApp campaign and logs analytics per tenant.
Fallback logic ensures continuity if WhatsApp fails.

example_use_cases.title: Catalog Upload
steps: Tenant accesses admin dashboard.
Uploads CSV or JSON catalog file.
System validates and stores products per tenant.
Catalog is available for WhatsApp bot queries.

example_use_cases.title: Fallback Payment Flow
steps: Bot detects payment failure or downtime.
Triggers fallback workflow (alternate payment, notification, or escalation).
Logs event and notifies admin for review.
